title: Duʿāʾ to Recognize Inner Talents and Strengths
arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ أَرَى الْمَوَاهِبَ وَنِقَاطَ قُوَّةِ الَّذِيْنَ وَضَعْتَهُ فِيْ نَفْسِيْ
transliteration: Allāhummaj-ʿalnī arāl-mawāhiba wa niqāṭa quwwatil-ladhīna waḍaʿtahu fī nafsī
translation: Oh Allah, make me see the talents and strengths you have put inside of me.
